newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Spadel swings to H1 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Spadel swings to H1 1996 profit.

text.p: NOTE - Spadel is a Belgian mineral water group.

In a statement Spadel said it hoped that lower raw material prices in the second half would allow it to compensate for a drop in summer sales and return a full year profit "at least equal to that of 1995".
Spadel said poor weather in July and August had left sales at the end of August nine percent down on 1995 levels. "This decrease cannot be recovered this year," it said.
Spadel said results in 1996 and subsequent years should also be helped by the abolition of certain direct taxes on mineral water and lower sales taxes.
